statement: Is every Sidorenko bipartite graph that contains a cycle forcing?

source.reference: The 2026 counterexample refutes the forcing conjecture only through the failure of the Sidorenko inequality (its Corollary 1.3, interpolation between kernels); Conlon, Fox and Sudakov note that forcing is stronger than Sidorenko.

observation: Every known refutation of forcing for a graph with a cycle passes through a failure of Sidorenko; the corrected statement asks whether the Sidorenko property with a cycle already forces quasirandomness.
neighbours: Is the forcing conjecture true for every weakly norming graph with a cycle? (known)
Is every edge-transitive bipartite graph with a cycle forcing?
notes: The forcing literature (Skokan-Thoma 2004, Li-Szegedy 2011, Kiem-Parczyk-Spiegel 2024) is not read in full by this record.

disposition.reason: Readiness: the decisive forcing literature is not read in full.
disposition.evidence_needed: Full readings of Skokan-Thoma 2004, Li-Szegedy 2011 and Kiem-Parczyk-Spiegel 2024, and a search for Sidorenko graphs with a cycle that are not forcing.
